Name: Codev
Author: Cluesmith
Description: Drive Codev's AI agent workflows from your Stream Deck. Approve gates, watch your builder fleet, step through diff reviews with dials, spawn builders from the backlog, and control your dev server, all without leaving your editor. Companion plugin for Codev (https://codevos.ai/): requires Codev and its Tower server running locally.

Actions.Name: Approve Gate
Actions.Tooltip: Acts on the selected builder: shows its pending gate; press to surface that gate's review for confirmation in VSCode.

Actions.Name: Send Feedback
Actions.Tooltip: Flush the selected builder's queued review feedback. Badge shows the queued count; inert when nothing is queued (or the workspace forwards immediately).

Actions.Name: Next / Attention
Actions.Tooltip: Badge of pending gates across the fleet; press to jump the selection to the builder needing attention, then approve on the Approve key.

Actions.Name: Codev Action
Actions.Tooltip: Run a Codev command (open terminals, view diff, send, spawn, refresh).

Actions.Name: Dev Server
Actions.Tooltip: Start / stop the workspace dev server.

Actions.Name: Builder Action
Actions.Tooltip: Live tile for the Nth builder (set the slot in the property inspector). Shows its issue + phase; press selects the builder and opens the artifact for its current phase (spec / plan / diff), or a fixed verb you choose.

Actions.Name: Zoom Navigator
Actions.Tooltip: Zoom navigator: rotate to browse workspaces / builders, tap the touch strip to zoom in (open the diff), press the dial to zoom back out / reset.

Actions.Name: PR Navigator
Actions.Tooltip: Browse open pull requests and open the selected one in the browser.

Actions.Name: Spawn from Backlog
Actions.Tooltip: Browse the backlog and spawn a builder for the selected issue (VSCode prompts the protocol).

Actions.Name: Review: Files / Headings
Actions.Tooltip: Review the selected builder's work; its phase picks the mode. Diff phase: step across files (press forwards the file to the builder, tap jumps to the first file). Spec/plan phase: step across headings in the artifact canvas (press opens the composer, tap jumps to the top).

TriggerDescription.Push: Forward file to builder (diff) or open composer (spec/plan)

Actions.Name: Review: Changes / Blocks
Actions.Tooltip: Review the selected builder's work; its phase picks the mode. Diff phase: step across changes within a file (press forwards the change to the builder, tap jumps to the first change). Spec/plan phase: step across blocks in the artifact canvas (press opens the composer, tap walks to the next commented block).

TriggerDescription.Push: Forward change to builder (diff) or open composer (spec/plan)
TriggerDescription.Touch: First change (diff) or next commented block (spec/plan)

Actions.Name: Scroll & Forward Selection
Actions.Tooltip: Rotate to scroll the active editor; press the dial to forward the current selection to the builder.
